A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 27-page manuscript, including Appendices A–D. Text, content-stream, and rendered-page comparisons establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original Diffusion Router experiments on Shoes-UMDT, Faces-UMDT, and COCO-UMDT, including FID/LPIPS results and ablations in Section 5 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark experiments, ablations, learning curves, and qualitative results in Section 5 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the identical domain-conditioned noise predictor, indirect routing, direct-translation objectives, and Tweedie refinement procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Shoes-UMDT, Faces-UMDT pixel/latent, and COCO-UMDT Star/Chain coverage and translation tasks described in Section 5.1.1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments: StarGAN, Rectified Flow, and UniDiffuser where evaluated, plus BBDM, I2SB, DDBM, and BDBM in Table 9.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix D retain identical splits, preprocessing, model sizes, training and finetuning budgets, sampling procedures, and FID/LPIPS metrics.

E4.justification: Appendix D.3 retains the same refinement-step, rehearsal-coefficient, training-from-scratch, sampling-budget, bridge-variant, and learning-rate analyses. The qualitative comparisons are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the point-estimate tables and learning curves. No run/seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance testing is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–10 and all plotted and qualitative results are identical. No reported rankings, trends, or findings change.

T1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendices A–B retain identical definitions, assumptions, KL derivations, variational-bound reasoning, and diffusion-bridge equations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion make identical claims about UMDT, the unified Diffusion Router, direct translation, scalability, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: The discussions of approximation bias, refinement imperfections, efficiency/quality trade-offs, forgetting, bridge behavior, and segmentation-decoding limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains identical architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, training-time, sampling, and post-processing details. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 62 cited works and identical research positioning in Section 6 and Appendix C.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 3 Dec 2025 to v3 dated 27 Jan 2026. Manuscript wording, headings, author information, and section organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All 13 figures and 10 tables retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Rendered pages match apart from the first-page version/date text; the document layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 only updates the arXiv version/date stamp and associated self-link. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
